mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past month indicates robust aggregate demand that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5% and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-growth economic regime (GDPC1 annual growth < 1%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a worsening supply shock that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 annual growth < 1% and INDPRO declines
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 annual growth < 1% and INDPRO declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past month indicates robust demand for residential construction that supports consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
